title: Remotes pane in Settings with Test and reachability
body:
Add a Settings pane to list, add, edit and delete Remotes, in the same custom-body style as the Keybindings pane. Includes the reachability probe (ssh -G to resolve host and port, then a TCP connect) and a Test action that reports login, shell, curl and agent CLIs. Both run off the UI thread.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-20-remote-sessions-design.md (sections: UI > Reachability, UI > Settings > Remotes)
Blocked by: Remote settings model and the SSH launch builder
Done when:
- Remotes can be added, edited and deleted from the pane with keyboard and mouse, and changes save through the existing debounced write
- reachability is probed only while the pane or the launcher is open, is cached, and never runs on the frame path
- Test fills in the shell field and shows a plain message when login needs a prompt
- ssh-config Host names are offered when adding
- probe parsing and the pane's pure model have unit tests
Gate: cargo test --target-dir target/agent settings_menu; cargo test --target-dir target/agent remote
